text: S649 reconciles every V03 gate and sets a no-churn completion plan. None is passed by reviewer opinion: Codex verified the matrix against source and output evidence. CLO 2026.1.310 modes are vendor-specific experiments only; tested Polo geometry and malformed/mark behavior fail, so that permutation family is stopped. Generic OpenCAD is not industrial profile proof. GetonAgain remains ineligible until rights/local DXF handling, install/run authorization, and exact input dialect/sidecar contract are verified. No new experiment is reserved. See E-G04-S649-EXIT and its linked matrix/plan/review. All acceptance, holds, legacy output and protected identities remain unchanged.
